preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 200.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(k for k in range(1, n + 1) if all(f_k(f_k(x)) == f_k(x) for x in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum positive integer k such that the function f applied k times (denoted f(k)) is idempotent, i.e., f(k)(f(k)(x)) = f(k)(x) for all x in {1, 2, ..., n}.
